verdict.rationale: cubic is an AI code-review product. Its documented agentic capability is limited to generating targeted fixes for review findings and pushing them to an existing PR branch. There is no evidence of a cloud agent that builds a new feature, runs tests on it, and produces a demo for review. The fix-on-review feature is adjacent and does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a cloud agent build, test, and demo a feature end-to-end for my review
